python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Treasury data (in millions)
europe_1991 = 268166
latam_1991 = 337565
europe_1996 = 426245
latam_1996 = 443872

# Germany's nominal GDP (in billions from World Bank)
germany_1991 = 1875792575132.59 / 1e9  # 1875.79 billion
germany_1996 = 2506576553158.31 / 1e9  # 2506.58 billion

# Round to 2 decimal places
germany_1991 = round(germany_1991, 2)  # 1875.79
germany_1996 = round(germany_1996, 2)  # 2506.58

print(f"Germany GDP 1991: {germany_1991} billion")
print(f"Germany GDP 1996: {germany_1996} billion")

# Germany's percentage growth rate
germany_growth = (germany_1996 - germany_1991) / germany_1991 * 100
print(f"Germany growth rate: {germany_growth:.4f}%")

# Linear regression: y = a + bx (using both points gives perfect fit)
# slope b = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1)
b = (latam_1996 - latam_1991) / (europe_1996 - europe_1991)
a = latam_1991 - b * europe_1991
print(f"Regression: slope={b:.6f}, intercept={a:.6f}")

# Counterfactual: Apply Germany's growth rate to June 1991 Europe value
counterfactual_europe = europe_1991 * (1 + germany_growth/100)
print(f"Counterfactual Europe (June 1996): {counterfactual_europe:.2f}")

# Use regression to predict Latin America value
predicted_latam = a + b * counterfactual_europe
print(f"Predicted Latin America (counterfactual): {predicted_latam:.2f}")

# Absolute difference from actual June 1996 Latin America value
abs_diff = latam_1996 - predicted_latam
print(f"Absolute difference: {abs_diff:.2f}")

# Express as percentage of actual June 1996 value
pct_of_actual = abs_diff / latam_1996 * 100
print(f"Percentage of actual: {pct_of_actual:.4f}%")

# U.S. total liabilities growth (Europe + Latin America & Caribbean)
us_1991 = europe_1991 + latam_1991
us_1996 = europe_1996 + latam_1996
us_growth_ratio = us_1996 / us_1991
print(f"US liabilities 1991: {us_1991}")
print(f"US liabilities 1996: {us_1996}")
print(f"US growth ratio: {us_growth_ratio:.6f}")

# Germany GDP growth ratio
germany_growth_ratio = germany_1996 / germany_1991
print(f"Germany GDP growth ratio: {germany_growth_ratio:.6f}")

# Final calculation
result = pct_of_actual * us_growth_ratio / germany_growth_ratio
print(f"\nFinal result: {result:.2f}")
EOF
